earnings.title: Venture Global Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: Revenue of $4.8 billion, an increase of 43% from Q3 2025, bringing year-to-date revenue to nearly $14 billion
Net income 1 of $2.5 billion, an increase of 493% from Q3 2025

Net income 1 and Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA 2 increased approximately $2.1 billion and $1.1 billion, respectively, for the three months ended September 30, 2026 as compared to the same period in 2025.

quotes.text: Venture Global had an exceptional third quarter, with record sales and earnings, enabled by our team's best-in-class execution and LNG production at the high end of our anticipated range.

outlook: Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA 1 guidance for the full year 2026 is $10.0 billion - $10.3 billion.

We assume a fixed liquefaction fee range of $21.00/MMBtu - $22.00/MMBtu for our remaining unsold cargos in 2026 in support of our guidance, reflecting market forward prices and recently executed cargo sales.

items.heading: Our ability to maintain profitability and positive operating cash flows is subject to significant uncertainty.

—Historical proceeds from commissioning cargo sales at the Calcasieu Project, which had an extended commissioning period due to unanticipated challenges with equipment reliability and which began producing LNG in a high-price environment, may not be indicative of the duration of the commissioning period or the amount of proceeds for any of our other projects or expansions thereof.
—Risks Relating to Regulation and Litigation—We may fail to receive the required approvals and permits from governmental and regulatory agencies for our projects.

Historical proceeds from commissioning cargo sales at the Calcasieu Project, which had an extended commissioning period due to unanticipated challenges with equipment reliability and which began producing LNG in a high-price environment, may not be indicative of the duration of the commissioning period or the amount of proceeds for any of our other projects or expansions thereof.
Our ability to generate proceeds from sales of commissioning cargos is subject to significant uncertainty and volatility in such proceeds, given significant volatility in spot-market prices.
Our ability to optimize sales of our LNG cargos is subject to significant uncertainty and volatility in proceeds generated from such sales.
